# jupiterone_controls (Data Source)

CCM controls matching a filter, with their evaluated compliance status. All filters are optional; with none set, every control is returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every filter is optional. With none set, all controls are returned.
data "jupiterone_controls" "failing_live" {
  states = ["LIVE"]
  status = ["FAIL"]
}

# Controls nobody is evaluating: live, but with no control tests attached.
data "jupiterone_controls" "unevaluated" {
  states        = ["LIVE"]
  effectiveness = "NO_TESTS"
}

# Passing only because somebody signed off, rather than because a test proves it.
data "jupiterone_controls" "attested_only" {
  states                = ["LIVE"]
  has_valid_attestation = true
}

# MITRE matching is by technique family: T1059 also returns controls tagged
# T1059.001, and T1059.001 also returns controls tagged T1059.
data "jupiterone_controls" "credential_access" {
  mitre_techniques = ["T1078", "T1110"]
}

output "failing_control_names" {
  value = [for c in data.jupiterone_controls.failing_live.controls : c.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `catalogs` (List of String) Return controls belonging to any of the given catalogs.
- `effectiveness` (String) Return controls with this effectiveness. Only NO_TESTS and NO_DATAPOINTS are filterable; EFFECTIVE is not supported as a filter by the API.
- `framework_id` (List of String) Return controls belonging to any of the given frameworks.
- `has_valid_attestation` (Boolean) Return only controls that do, or do not, hold a valid attestation. Independent of status.
- `mitre_techniques` (List of String) Return controls tagged with any of the given MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Matching is by technique family, so T1059 also returns controls tagged T1059.001, and vice versa.
- `ou` (List of String) Return controls related to entities in any of the given organisational units.
- `owner` (String) Return controls with this owner, matched exactly against a user email.
- `search_text` (String) Case insensitive search across name, description, identifier and id.
- `states` (List of String) Return controls in any of the given lifecycle states: DRAFT, REVIEW, LIVE or RETIRED.
- `status` (List of String) Return controls whose status is any of PASS or FAIL.

### Read-Only

- `controls` (Attributes List) The matching controls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--controls))
- `id` (String) A generated identifier for this result set.

<a id="nestedatt--controls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `controls`

Read-Only:

- `catalog` (String) The catalog the control belongs to, e.g. CIS Controls v8.
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the control is configured.
- `created_on` (String) When the control was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the control.
- `effective_status` (String) Whether the control is producing usable results: NO_TESTS, NO_DATAPOINTS or EFFECTIVE. NO_TESTS means no control test is defined; NO_DATAPOINTS means the tests returned no data.
- `exception_process` (String) Exception process in markdown format.
- `framework_ids` (List of String) The frameworks this control belongs to.
- `has_valid_attestation` (Boolean) Whether the control holds at least one valid, unexpired and unrevoked attestation. Independent of status: a failing control test is never masked by an attestation.
- `id` (String) The ID of the control.
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the control, e.g. IDAM3.5.
- `last_evaluated_on` (String) When the control was last evaluated.
- `mitre_technique` (String) The MITRE ATT&CK technique ID this control relates to.
- `name` (String) The name of the control.
- `number_of_tests` (Number) How many control tests the control has.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the control, represented by a user email.
- `remediation` (String) Remediation steps in markdown format.
- `resource_group_id` (String) The resource group the control is scoped to.
- `source` (String) Where the control came from: J1, UCF, UPLOAD or JSON.
- `source_id` (String) The identifier of the control in its source.
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state of the control: DRAFT, REVIEW, LIVE or RETIRED.
- `status` (String) The evaluated compliance status, PASS or FAIL. Only populated for LIVE controls. A control covered solely by a valid attestation reads as PASS; attestation coverage is reported separately by has_valid_attestation.
